maya (ml-infra): quick Q — trying to tune alerts for Dedicated GPU pools. Where can I find a dashboard that shows per-GPU SM% (util), GPU memory usage, KV-cache hit/miss, and batch_size distribution? need links + any existing alert rules.

sam (runtime): checkout Grafana -> 
https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/3U8gkGk/gpu-pool-overview?orgId=1
panels: SM% (panel 4), GPU mem (panel 7), kvcache hitrate (panel 12), batch size histogram (panel 15).

eli (sre): adding that link to runbook would help. current alerts are pretty coarse: 
- gpu_sm_percent < 20% (5m) -> warn
- gpu_mem_free < 10% -> critical
we don't alert on kv cache yet.

nina (observability): for kv cache we pull KV hits from runtime exporter -> metric name: runtime_kvcache_hit_ratio (gauge). Grafana query is: 
```
avg by (gpu) (rate(runtime_kvcache_hits[5m]) / rate(runtime_kvcache_lookups[5m]))
```
suggest threshold: warn if < 0.6 for 10m, critical if < 0.4 for 5m (but depends on model length).

maya (ml-infra): thanks. where do we see batch size distribution? need p50/p95 per-model across the pool.

sam (runtime): batch size hist panels use the histogram buckets from runtime_batch_size_bucket. query: 
```
sum by (le, model) (rate(runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m]))
```
then the dashboard computes p50/p95. Direct link to model breakdown: 
https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/3U8gkGk/gpu-pool-overview?view=model-breakdown

benchy-bot: automated-run: reported recent spike in p95 batch size for model: openai-falcon-40b-qlora on pool: dev-dedicated-2. See alert: https://alerts.redwood.ai/ALERT-9821

eli (sre): re: tuning alerts — two operational notes: 
1) don't trigger kvcache alerts during nightly heavy inference jobs (we have a label job_type). add `unless job_type =~ "batch"` to rule.
2) SM% low is often due to tiny batch sizes after autoscale down; only fire if avg_batch_size < 4. Example rule snippet: 
```
avg_over_time(gpu_sm_util[5m]) < 0.2 and avg_over_time(runtime_avg_batch_size[5m]) < 4
```

nina (observability): i'll stub a dashboard link in the runbook and add the kvcache panels. also will add an alert playbook with runbook links. pinging @sam for review. :eyes:

sam (runtime): lgtm, will review thresholds. also quick ask: if someone is free can you post the grafana panel ids? need to wire them into the new oncall page.

maya (ml-infra): I can do that today. ping me if i miss anything.

eli (sre): FYI, ops-bot will post aggregate GPU utilization summary to #eng-sre every morning at 09:00 UTC. ops-bot: can you include kvcache hit ratios per pool?

ops-bot: ✅ scheduled. will include per-pool kvcache_hit_ratio, avg batch size p95, and sm% p95 in the morning digest.

maya (ml-infra): perfect. last thing — can someone drop the Prometheus alertmanager rule snippet into this thread so I can copy it?

nina (observability): here is a draft AM rule to start with: 
```
- alert: LowKVCaching
  expr: avg by (pool) (rate(runtime_kvcache_lookups[10m])) > 0 and
        avg by (pool) (rate(runtime_kvcache_hits[10m]) / rate(runtime_kvcache_lookups[10m])) < 0.6
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache hit ratio low for {{ $labels.pool }}"
    runbook: "https://runbooks.redwood.ai/kv-cache-low"
```

sam (runtime): thanks — i'll adapt it to exclude batch jobs and add a critical threshold.

maya (ml-infra): awesome, thanks everyone. I'll follow up after i update the Dedicated runbook. :rocket:
